visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in the kitchen of a local eatery where a male chef in a grey t-shirt and light blue face mask is seen behind a stainless steel counter preparing food. To his left, various yellow menu boards and signs are visible on a metal stand, and an industrial exhaust fan spins above. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of the shop during the day, showing a closed metal roller shutter and a few customers waiting outside, including a woman in a brown shirt and a young woman wearing a black motorcycle helmet. (3) The camera returns to the kitchen where the chef is seen carefully placing thin noodles into a metal bowl using chopsticks. (4) Close-up shots of the food follow, starting with a bowl of thin dry noodles topped with brown minced meat sauce and a large braised egg. A pair of metal chopsticks lifts a large portion of the noodles, revealing their texture and the steam rising from them. (5) Another close-up shows a stainless steel bowl of clear soup containing slices of meat and ginger shreds, which are lifted by a metal spoon to show the tenderness of the meat. (6) A plate of assorted braised side dishes (lu wei) is displayed, featuring sliced kelp, bean curd, and pink sausage-like items topped with chopped green onions. A piece of the sausage is dipped into a small dollop of red chili oil. (7) The final shot shows the shop's red sign with yellow characters '原味古早麵' and the street address '高雄市鼓山區西藏街277號' as the camera pans upwards towards the building.
